main.description: Asks this appview's gateway whether the delegation is approved (dev.knotless.getDelegation), which waits a while for it before saying it is not yet: ask again until done. Once done, the appview remembers the gateway for the account, so that sharing a repository for writing from the pages names it. A procedure, since it writes that. Requires the session cookie the pages' login sets.

errors.description: No such delegation waits, or the account refused the grant.
errors.name: InvalidRequest

errors.description: No account is logged in to the pages, or its session has ended.
errors.name: AuthenticationRequired

state.description: The delegation, as dev.knotless.delegateWrites named it.

done.description: Whether it was approved: false while it waits still.

gateway.description: Once done, the gateway that now writes for the account.

description: Waits a while for the account logged in to this appview's pages to approve a delegation dev.knotless.delegateWrites started.
